newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares firm, pushed up by Dolenjska bank.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares firm, pushed up by Dolenjska bank.

text.p: Slovenian shares firmed 0.55 percent on Monday, boosted by a rise in Dolenjska bank, after it said it planned to introduce a 15-percent foreign stake in the bank.
Traders predicted the index could oscillate by 1.5 percent either way until Wednesday when a four-day holiday break starts.
The market could grow up to 30 percent in May when foreign buying is expected to resume, they noted.
* The blue-chip SBI index firmed 7.29 points to 1,322.4.
* Ordinary shares of bank Dolenjska banka had the highest turnover, up 3.33 percent to 15,500 on volume of 1,470 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
